notes: Machine-readable mirror of the authoritative budget table in docs/dev/features.md section 0.5.3.
Every value here is cross-checked against that table by `xtask budget --validate`; a mismatch fails the gate.
Units: latency_ms = milliseconds, memory_mb = mebibytes of RSS, cpu_pct = percent of one core, size_mb = mebibytes, *_count = occurrences, net_sockets = process-external sockets.
